info.name: Sahla API
info.description:
Requests for the Sahla Spring Boot backend. Covers Authentication, Farmers, Products, Grades, and Pricing.

Known gap #1 (Farmers/Products): /api/auth/register always creates a WAREHOUSE_EMPLOYEE account and there is currently no API to assign ADMIN/MANAGER/RECEIVING_EMPLOYEE roles. Farmer endpoints require ADMIN, MANAGER, or RECEIVING_EMPLOYEE; Product create/update require ADMIN or MANAGER. Until role assignment exists, requests marked '(blocked by role gap)' below are correctly built against the API contract but will return 403 Forbidden when run with a self-registered account.

Known gap #2 (Grades/Pricing): this code lives on PR #7 / branch amansayrawan-patch-1, which does not compile as pushed - GradeDefinitionUpdateRequest, and the exception classes DuplicateResourceException/InvalidPricingException/ResourceNotFoundException under com.farmmanagement.backend.exception, are referenced but don't exist in the branch. Requests marked '(branch does not compile)' are built from the controller/service source as the intended contract and will start working once those classes are added and exception handling is wired up. That branch also never restricted Grades/Pricing endpoints by role, unlike Farmers/Products.

Requests that only need GET on Products, or that expect 401/403, are runnable today.

Import the sibling environment file and select it before running requests. Run the Authentication folder first so {{authToken}} is populated.

item.name: Farmers
item.description: Backend from feature/implement-farmer-and-product-backend. All endpoints require ADMIN, MANAGER, or RECEIVING_EMPLOYEE (see SecurityConfig); PUT additionally excludes RECEIVING_EMPLOYEE. A self-registered account defaults to WAREHOUSE_EMPLOYEE, which is not in either allow-list, so every request below except 'Unauthenticated' and 'Wrong Role' will return 403 until role assignment exists. There is no duplicate/conflict case for Farmers: farmerCode is generated server-side (UUID-based), so no user-supplied field can collide.

item.name: Grades
item.description: Backend from PR #7 (branch amansayrawan-patch-1, GradeDefinitionController). NOT RUNNABLE YET: the branch does not compile. GradeDefinitionController and GradeDefinitionService both import com.farmmanagement.backend.dto.GradeDefinitionUpdateRequest, but that class does not exist anywhere in the branch. GradeDefinitionService also imports com.farmmanagement.backend.exception.DuplicateResourceException and com.farmmanagement.backend.exception.ResourceNotFoundException, neither of which exist either (there's a different ResourceNotFoundException under common.exception used by the Auth/Farmer/Product code, but that's a different class in a different package). The requests below are built from the controller/service source as the intended contract; the PUT body for updateGrade is inferred from GradeDefinitionService.updateGrade (name, description, displayOrder, active) since the real DTO is missing. Also note: this branch never touched SecurityConfig, so once it compiles, these endpoints only require .anyRequest().authenticated() - any logged-in role can call them, including create/update. That's inconsistent with how Farmers/Products lock create/update to ADMIN/MANAGER and worth a call with the leader.

item.name: Pricing
item.description: Backend from PR #7 (branch amansayrawan-patch-1, PriceRuleController). Cleaner than the Grades folder - PriceRuleRequest/PriceRuleUpdateRequest/PriceRuleResponse and the exceptions they throw (ResourceNotFoundException, InvalidPricingException from com.farmmanagement.backend.exception) still don't exist in the branch, so it's in the same 'does not compile' state as Grades. Same SecurityConfig gap too: no role restriction was added for these endpoints, so once it compiles any authenticated role can create/update prices. Currency is an enum: USD or LBP.
